name: polyglot-media
description: Practice-box malicious-media finding: places a file named like an MP3 in the shared media shelf, but its body is an executable shell payload.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

install -d -m 0755 /var/media
cat > /var/media/golden-ticket.mp3 <<'MEDIA'
#!/bin/sh
# Training-only fake media payload; do not execute files solely because of their extension.
printf '%s\n' "fake golden-ticket media payload" >> /var/log/cocoa-media.log
MEDIA
chmod 0644 /var/media/golden-ticket.mp3
